ThumbPilot

Client: Shaurya Studios×2024
OVERVIEW

ThumbPilot was born from a recurring need in my video editing pipeline: objectively predicting thumbnail performance before publishing. I designed and engineered it as a standalone SaaS product.

THE CHALLENGE

Existing tools relied on basic contrast checks or generic A/B testing. We needed an intelligent engine that could parse visual hierarchy, text legibility, and emotional impact against YouTube's algorithm.

THE APPROACH

The Analysis Engine. I designed the entire interface around a central 'upload and dissect' mechanic. The UI feels like a diagnostic tool rather than a standard dashboard, utilizing monospace data readouts and stark contrast to focus purely on the visual metrics.

Technologies

  • Next.js
  • React
  • Tailwind CSS
  • OpenAI Vision API
  • Vercel

Services

  • Product Design
  • Frontend Engineering
  • Full-Stack Development
RESULT

Engineered a scalable architecture capable of processing and analyzing thumbnails in under 3 seconds.
